paragraphs: R' Yehuda bar Sotas. See the entry R' Yehuda bar Titus.[^1]

notes.text: סוטס, conventionally Sotas, and טיטוס, Titus, remain different supplied patronymics; Sotas’s exact vowels are uncertain. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
